item.title: The EU May Be Going After Apple Maps Next
item.description: Apple Maps and Apple Ads may face new EU regulations after hitting the DMA's 45 million user threshold. Apple argues neither should be designated as a "gatekeeper."

item.title: Intel Inside? Apple May Tap an Old Rival to Build the M7
item.description: A new report from Ming-Chi Kuo claims Apple may tap Intel to manufacture the M7 chip in 2027. The move would hand Apple's entry-level silicon production to a US-owned firm for the first time, diversifying away from TSMC.

item.title: India Mandates Undeletable Government App on iPhones
item.description: India has ordered Apple to install a mandatory "cyber safety" app on all iPhones. The government-developed app cannot be deleted, raising major privacy concerns.
